mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_commission (policy_no, company_id, company_name, premium, tax_flag, commission_rate, commission_amount, direction, status, policy_date, settle_date, receipt_id, payment_id, policy_user, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{policyNo}, #{companyId}, #{companyName}, #{premium}, #{taxFlag}, #{commissionRate}, #{commissionAmount}, #{direction}, #{status}, #{policyDate}, #{settleDate}, #{receiptId}, #{paymentId}, #{policyUser}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fin_commission WHERE id IN #{id}
